title: Introducing Binance Lite Loan: Simple Borrowing, Unlock Instant Liquidity
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Terms and conditions apply. Fellow Binancians, Binance Loans is excited to introduce a new product to its lending offerings.  Lite Loan  — an intuitive fixed term loan product that lets users instantly borrow stablecoins by pledging eligible collateral. No complex LTV monitoring, no price-triggered liquidation during the initial 30-day Loan Term, and your collateral keeps earning yield throughout the loan term. Product Offerings: Eligible Borrow Asset: USDT Eligible Collateral Asset: BTC Borrow Cap per user: 1,000 USDT Loan Term: 30 days Fee: 0.5%* upfront service fee. *The 0.5% fee rate only applies during the Promotion Period and will revert to 1% after the promotion ends. Repayment: Repay with the borrowed asset or other supported crypto assets. Please note: Borrowable assets, collateral, maximum loan amounts, fees, and other terms are subject to change based on market conditions. Please refer to the  Lite Loan application page   for the most updated information. Binance Lite Loan - Promotional Offer During the Promotion Period, the upfront service fee for Lite Loan will be  reduced to 0.5%  (standard rate: 1%). All other product terms remain unchanged. Promotion Period:  2026-08-04 10:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-03 09:59 (UTC) Promotion mechanics: Original Upfront Service Fee Rate  1% Upfront Service Fee Rate During the Promotion Period 0.5% Please note: The promotional rate applies to borrowings initiated successfully during the Promotion Period only. The upfront service fee is  non-refundable , including in the event of early repayment. Binance reserves the right to modify or terminate this promotion at any time without prior notice. Key Features of Lite Loans: Instant Liquidity:  Borrowed funds are available immediately and can be used both on and off the Binance platform. Predictable Borrowing Cost:  A flat upfront service fee with no additional interest for the initial 30-day term. Keep Earning While You Borrow:  Collateral assets remain subscribed to Simple Earn Flexible products and continue generating yield throughout the loan term. Simple to Manage:  No LTV management required during the initial 30-day term. An alert at the applicable margin call LTV (currently 85%) will notify you if your LTV is approaching the liquidation threshold post-term. Borrow, use the funds, and repay on time. No price-triggered liquidation during the loan term:  Collateral will not be subject to liquidation due to price fluctuations during the initial 30-day loan term. Post-Term Liquidation Threshold:  If your loan becomes overdue, liquidation will be triggered if your LTV reaches the applicable liquidation threshold (currently 91%) or when the loan remains overdue for 30 days,  whichever comes first . How to Get Started with Binance Lite Loan: Website Step 1: Navigate to  [ Lite Loan ] . Step 2: Click  [Borrow Now]  and enter the borrow amount, and ensure you have a sufficient amount of collateral in your account, then click  [Next]. Step 3: Read and agree to the terms and click  [Confirm]  to receive funds instantly. App Step 1: Go to the Search bar and search for  [Loans] , or tap  [More]  on the App homepage and look for the Lite Loan under  [Loans]  section. Step 2: Tap  [Borrow Now]  and enter the borrow amount, and ensure you have a sufficient amount of collateral in your account, then tap  [Continue]. Step 3: Read and agree to the terms and tap  [Confirm]  to receive funds instantly. Get Started With Binance Lite Loan Today! For More Information: Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Lite Loan Terms & Conditions: Changes to Binance Lite Loan terms may be revised by Binance from time to time following evaluation of market conditions. Please refer to   Binance Lite Loan Terms and Conditions  and  Risk Warning  for more information prior to using the Lite Loan services. Fee:  The upfront fee is charged at the time of borrowing from the loan amount and is non-refundable, including in cases of early repayment. The promotional fee rate of 0.5% applies only to loan orders initiated during the Promotion Period. For example, the campaign ends on  2026-09-03 09:59 (UTC) , any loan order initiated before that time will qualify for the 0.5% promotional fee rate. Collateral:  If eligible collateral is held in the user’s Spot or Funding Account, it will be automatically subscribed to  Simple Earn Flexible Products  and locked as collateral for the duration of the loan, during which it will continue to generate yield. Users cannot withdraw or transfer locked collateral while the loan is outstanding. Collateral will be returned to the user’s Earn Account upon full repayment only. Repay:  Early and partial repayments are supported at no extra charge. Repayment can be made using the borrowed coin or other eligible assets. Penalty interest:  After the expiry date, a penalty interest accrues  daily  at a fixed simple annual rate of 36% on the outstanding balance. Margin Call : When the LTV reaches 85%, a margin call notification will be sent. To reduce LTV, users can repay part or all of their outstanding loan. Liquidation:  Liquidation is triggered if the LTV reaches 91% or the loan remains overdue for 30 days,  whichever comes first .  If liquidation occurs, the entire loan will be repaid using the collateral for that loan position.  Currently, the applicable liquidation fee is 0% . Binance may change the Liquidation Fee Rate at any time in its sole discretion, including reinstating it to the standard 2% as provided in the  Binance Lite Loan Terms and Conditions . In addition, Binance may apply a risk-based liquidation adjustment to each collateral asset as part of the liquidation process. This adjustment is calculated by applying the applicable  Risk-Based Liquidation Ratio  to the asset’s market value at the time of liquidation, as determined by Binance.  Only master accounts are eligible to participate in Lite Loan borrowing.
